chunks: And he asked him about a musk pouch being with a person who is praying while it is in his pocket or his clothes. He said: “There is no harm in that.”

key_terms.فَأْرَةِ: a musk pouch or small container associated with musk
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to carry a musk pouch in one’s pocket or clothes during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding carrying a musk pouch during salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem with praying while it is in one’s pocket or clothing.
